svg.title: In-App Notifications and Scheduled Reminders — code design
svg.desc: Admin / Coach / Athlete: receive and manage their own notifications. SUNNY: source action commits + outbox event -> resolve recipients -> persist notifications -> refresh bell -> open one -> mark read + authorized navigation -> View All -> filter/manage history. REMINDERS: Pending at 09:00 local two calendar days before start -> one reminder; Available/Unavailable or already-sent -> skip. Confirmed events on one participation date -> one consolidated day-before reminder. CONDITIONAL / CANCELLATION: exclude unconfirmed Conditional sessions; introduce no qualification workflow. Cancellation notifies affected athletes + staff and suppresses future reminders. UNDO: delete removes immediately -> restore within 5 seconds returns prior read state; expired restore rejected. No notifications / no unread -> appropriate empty state. FAILURE / PRIVACY: retry durable triggers without duplicates; mutation failures reconcile UI; unavailable destination shows a message. Every recipient query and destination read enforces current authorization.

SUNNY: source action commits + outbox event -> resolve recipients -> persist notifications -> refresh bell -> open one -> mark read + authorized navigation -> View All -> filter/manage history.

REMINDERS: Pending at 09:00 local two calendar days before start -> one reminder; Available/Unavailable or already-sent -> skip. Confirmed events on one participation date -> one consolidated day-before
CONDITIONAL / CANCELLATION: exclude unconfirmed Conditional sessions; introduce no qualification workflow. Cancellation notifies affected athletes + staff and suppresses future reminders.
